observation.speech_raw: heading level 1  City Library Expands Evening Hours
The Riverside City Library will stay open until 9 p.m. on weekdays starting in April, the board announced on Tuesday. The change follows a survey in which
most respondents asked for later hours.

Front entrance of the Riverside City Library at dusk
  Graphic
Membership costs $5.99 a month, e.g. for adults; children join free. Questions go to help@riverside-library.org — or call 555-0142. Attendance rose 3.5%
last year, and staff say they can't wait.
• Weekend hours, which do not change:
Finally, I can study after work.
The library board will review attendance in the fall. A long-standing complaint among students and working parents was that the reading rooms closed before
most people finished their day, so the extended schedule is intended to make the collections, the public computers, and the quiet study spaces available
at the times when the community actually needs them, according to the library director.
